items.description: Democrats can block Trump's legislative agenda, launch investigations but don't have the numbers to override his veto.

items.title: In Ukraine, Russia intensifies strikes on civilian targets
items.description: A bombing in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region on Monday struck a school that was also serving as a humanitarian aid distribution center that day, killing at least 33 people and leaving around 50 missing, according to the latest figures.

items.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
items.description: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.

items.title: Yemen: Houthi clashes near Taiz leave residents in a 'state of panic'
items.description: Fighting between Iran-backed Houthi rebels and Yemeni government forces has intensified around the city of Taiz. Residents face growing shortages of food, water and medical supplies as thousands flee their homes.

items.title: World News in Brief: Children killed in Myanmar strike, new violence flares in Mozambique, an Internet affordability milestone
items.description: A school in Myanmar has been hit in an airstrike, with three children reported killed and five others injured, according to UN Children’s Fund UNICEF.

items.title: Ukrainian Crowd Clashes With Riot Police, Again Highlighting Recruitment Tactics, Military Morale
items.description: A crowd clashed with police and National Guard troops in a Kyiv suburb amid allegations that men were being held and tortured in a private house. The incident highlights growing tensions over Ukraine’s controversial military recruitment practices as it strives to repel Russia’s full-scale invasion.

items.title: At Least 31 Killed in Russian Bomb Attack in Zaporizhzhia
items.description: Ukrainian officials said Russia bombed a school being used as an aid distribution point in a village in the village of Komyshuvakha.

items.title: Russia Preparing Massive Strike on Ukraine, Says Zelensky
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is preparing another massive attack on Ukraine, potentially exploiting international attention on the US midterm elections. The warning follows a deadly Russian strike in Zaporizhzhia and comes ahead of US-mediated peace talks scheduled for Nov. 10-11 in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: What we know about the alert app hack in Ukraine and Russia
items.description: Both Ukraine and Russia say their air raid alert apps were cyber-attacked - Joe Tidy explains what we know so far.
